objective: Define a future bounded temporary-capital lease architecture that may improve utilization of genuinely idle sleeve capital without changing home-sleeve ownership, weakening strategy admission, or allowing double-spend.
prerequisites_before_runtime_design: Stage E/F/G machinery lineage complete and exact final SHA known.
Genuine shared $500 PAPER portfolio epoch initialized and four lane adapters active.
Natural utilization telemetry available for all four lanes over a representative span.
Evidence that meaningful capital is persistently idle while another lane has qualified executable demand.
A separately reviewed attribution policy for borrower strategy performance versus funding-owner capital.

model.name: bounded_temporary_capital_lease
model.ownership: Capital retains a home/funding sleeve identity; a lease temporarily grants reservation authority to a different borrower lane.

idle_capital_definition_requirements: Only reconciled available capital can be considered idle.
Open basis and active reservations are never idle.
A home lane must retain a policy-defined protected reserve before any lease is granted.
Idle classification must be time-bounded and derived from canonical portfolio/lane state, not from absence of recent trades alone.
Exact idle-duration and protected-reserve thresholds remain unset until utilization evidence exists.
borrower_requirements: A lease cannot create a qualification; borrower must already have a normal qualified opportunity.
Borrower uses its normal entry, freshness, generation, concentration, creator/distribution, turnover/depth, execution-stress and breadth controls.
Borrowed capital is an additional hard cap only; execution controls remain downsize-only.
Borrower cannot exceed a separately frozen per-lane and portfolio exposure ceiling.
One lease cannot be used for multiple unrelated lifecycle reservations.
recall_and_return_requirements: A lender recall request may stop new deployment of uncommitted leased capital.
A lender recall does not force-close an already-open borrower position.
Deployed leased principal returns only through the borrower's normal terminal/realization accounting or another separately certified deterministic unwind rule.
Returned principal becomes available to the funding-owner sleeve only after canonical settlement/reconciliation.
Crash/restart must reconstruct lease state without freeing capital twice.
accounting_and_attribution_requirements: The shared portfolio accountant is the sole cross-lane cash authority.
Native lane books remain strategy/lifecycle evidence and may not independently transfer capital between lanes.
Each leased dollar must retain both funding-owner and strategy-owner provenance.
Principal ownership and strategy economic contribution must never be conflated or double-counted.
Final lane profitability/drawdown attribution rules are intentionally not frozen by this architecture contract.
Portfolio-level realized P&L remains canonical and must reconcile regardless of future lane attribution choice.
utilization_telemetry_required_before_pa: qualified opportunities blocked only by capital
qualified opportunities downsized by capital versus execution capacity
time capital remains available while no home-lane qualified demand exists
counterfactual portfolio return/drawdown under bounded lease candidates
required_future_proofs: Competing borrower requests serialize deterministically under the portfolio writer.
A lease cannot make available cash negative or allow the same principal to be reserved twice.
Restart/redelivery is idempotent across request, grant, deployment, settlement and return.
A funding-owner lane cannot reserve capital currently deployed under an active lease.
Borrower terminal loss cannot exceed the separately certified lease/position risk authority.
Recall of uncommitted capital is safe and recall of deployed capital never bypasses strategy exit rules.
Portfolio and lane provenance remain auditable across every lease event.
composition_position: Post-E/F/G and after base prepared strategy stack; only if utilization evidence justifies promotion.
compatibility_note: directional-realized-equity-sizing-v1 continues to require no cross-sleeve borrowing until this architecture is separately parameterized, implemented, certified, and explicitly promoted.
